title: Welcome to Outlooker
note: All data stays on this computer. No account, no upload.

language.heading: Pick your interface language
language.body: You can change this later in Settings.

location.heading: Where should mail data be stored?
location.body: Imported mail, indexes and images take about 60–80% of the original PST size. Pick a disk with enough free space.
location.defaultHint: Your user folder — right for most people
location.otherHint: For example an external or larger drive

database.heading: Preparing the local database
database.body: This happens once and takes about 20 seconds.

import.heading: Import your first PST
import.body: Import runs in the background. You can search what is already imported while it runs.

feature.title: What Outlooker does
feature.search: Search a million messages in seconds
feature.searchBody: Find mail by sender, recipient or a fragment of the body, in Chinese and English.
feature.dedupeBody: A message found in several PST files is stored once, with every place it came from.
feature.renderBody: HTML is cleaned, and inline images are kept as WebP.
feature.localBody: The database starts and stops with the app. No account and no network.
